The main takeaway from our work is that
for optimal displacement accuracy it is not necessary to remove the grating lobes completely by low-pass filtering.
for optimal axial displacement estimation accuracy in the presence of strong grating lobe distortions it is beneficial to not remove the grating lobes by low-pass filtering.
it is important to consider the tradeoff between the grating lobs artifacts and the main lobe signals when filtering RF data for displacement estimation.
